nodes.text:
🚨 Important information about #hmpvvirus 

HMPV is generally not a deadly virus and most people contract it before the age of 5.

Common Symptoms Include:
•Cough
•Fever
•Runny or stuffy nose
•Sore throat
•Wheezing
•Shortness of breath (dyspnea)
•Rash
